title: Provide instructions to improve CLAUDE.md
body:
I'd love tips on how to use your prompt improver to improve `CLAUDE.md` instructions!

Your best practices [post](https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/claude-code-best-practices) says this:

> At Anthropic, we occasionally run CLAUDE.md files through the [prompt improver](https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/build-with-claude/prompt-engineering/prompt-improver) and often tune instructions (e.g. adding emphasis with "IMPORTANT" or "YOU MUST") to improve adherence.

But the prompt improver needs the prompt to be a template

https://console.anthropic.com/dashboard

"Prompt templates must be reusable to improve them"

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d28443a5-7238-4742-ae1c-b9509e48d02e)

The auto-templatize doesn't quite work in this setting (at least with the `CLAUDE.md` I [had](https://github.com/broadinstitute/starrynight/blob/60d014b32f046cb21f4558cdb88ea4a99096ab39/starrynight/tests/CLAUDE.md))


![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b3d43194-423b-42b9-b70a-9b653b39ab6f)
